newsitem.title: USA: Southwest flight lands safely after bomb threat.
newsitem.headline: Southwest flight lands safely after bomb threat.

text.p: A Southwest Airlines Co jet made an emergency landing in Pensacola on Friday after receiving a bomb threat, a police spokeswoman said.

Southwest flight 475 was on its way from New Orleans to Orlando when the threat was made, the spokeswoman said. The Boeing 737 was diverted to land at the nearby Pensacola Regional Airport at 8:15 a.m. CST (1415 GMT).
All 39 passengers and five crew members were evacuated safely, she said.
The spokeswoman said a note was passed to the captain of the plane indicating a bomb was aboard but no other details were immediately available.
